title: Delight Shopping Mart
metaTitle: Delight Shopping Mart: Online Supermarket Case Study
metaDescription: Case study of Delight Shopping Mart, an installable online supermarket for Tulsipur and Ghorahi with store choice, categories, cart and home delivery.
summary: An online supermarket for Tulsipur and Ghorahi in Dang, Nepal, with store choice, a full category menu, offers, a cart and home delivery.
overview: Delight Shopping Mart is an online supermarket that lets people in Tulsipur and Ghorahi order everyday groceries and household goods for home delivery. It is my most recent main project.

The shop runs two stores, so the first thing a visitor does is choose which store to order from. Products, stock and delivery come from the store they choose. At the time of writing, both stores open from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and the delivery fee is shown next to each store.
does: Store chooser for the Tulsipur and Ghorahi branches, with opening hours and delivery information
Category menu: Groceries, Snacks, Beauty, Baby Care, Cleaning, Kitchen, Stationery, Toys, Gifts & Puja and Deals
Festival offer banners and discount badges on product cards, with prices in NPR
Search, account, wishlist, cart and order tracking
Installable web app (PWA), so customers can add it to their phone's home screen
role: I designed and built the whole website, front-end and back-end.

title: NextOwner
metaTitle: NextOwner: Campus Marketplace PWA Case Study
metaDescription: Case study of NextOwner, an installable campus marketplace where students buy, sell and swap items, with categories, search and messaging.
summary: A campus marketplace where students buy, sell and swap with each other, built as an installable web app.
overview: NextOwner is a marketplace made for students. Instead of posting on crowded social media groups, students list what they no longer need and find what they do, inside one place built for campus life.
It is an installable web app (PWA), so it opens quickly from the home screen on a phone. The home screen leads with featured listings and a clear way to list an item for free.
does: Browse and search listings, with categories such as Electronics, Furniture, Books, Appliances, Vehicles, Hostel, Clothes and Others
List an item for free, and buy, sell or swap with other students
Sign-in, messages between buyers and sellers, and notifications
Featured items with verified-seller badges
Installable on a phone like a normal app
role: I designed and built the product.

title: PrintCloud
metaTitle: PrintCloud: QR Code Printing Service Case Study
metaDescription: Case study of PrintCloud, a print service built for Nepal: scan a QR code at a print shop, upload documents, pay with eSewa and get your prints.
summary: A print service built for Nepal: scan a shop's QR code, upload a document, pay with eSewa and the prints come out automatically.
overview: Printing at a shop usually means sending files over a chat app and waiting while the shopkeeper opens each one by hand. PrintCloud replaces that with a flow the customer controls from their own phone.
The customer scans the QR code at a print shop, uploads their document, pays with eSewa, and the print job goes to the shop's printer without anyone handling the file.
does: QR code at each shop that opens that shop's upload page
Upload of PDF, DOC, JPG, PNG and other common file types
Payment through eSewa, the wallet many people in Nepal already use
Automatic printing with no manual steps for the shopkeeper
Privacy by design: files are removed automatically after printing
Installable on a phone, with a prompt to add it to the home screen
role: I designed and built the product.

title: RushIT
metaTitle: RushIT: Cybersecurity Company Website Case Study
metaDescription: Case study of the RushIT website, a dark, high-contrast site for a cybersecurity and IT consulting company covering services and federal resources.
summary: A website for a cybersecurity and IT consulting company, presenting its services, what sets it apart and its federal resources.
overview: RushIT is a cybersecurity and IT consulting company that serves business and government clients. Its website needed to look credible and serious, and to make its services easy to scan.
I designed a dark, high-contrast layout with a gold accent, a strong headline about delivering effective security solutions, and a clear route to get in touch.
does: Sections for Services, Differentiators, Performance and Federal Resources
A confident hero with a single clear call to action
Responsive layout that reads well on phones and desktops
Fast loading, with images sized for the web
role: I designed and built the website for the client.

title: Uttarakhand Seva Nidhi
metaTitle: Uttarakhand Seva Nidhi: Charity Website Case Study
metaDescription: Case study of the Uttarakhand Seva Nidhi website, a bright, readable site for a public charitable trust focused on environmental education.
summary: A website for a public charitable trust working on environmental education and women's leadership in the hills of Uttarakhand.
overview: Uttarakhand Seva Nidhi is a public charitable trust that runs environmental education programmes in rural schools and villages. Its website has to explain a long history and many programmes without overwhelming a first-time visitor.
I used a fresh green colour scheme, a large photo slider that shows the work in action, and a short statement of purpose at the top: building sustainable communities through education and action.
does: Sections for Mission, About, Events, Publications and Our Work
Photo slider and clear calls to action: Our Programs and Get Involved
Readable typography and strong contrast
Responsive layout for visitors on phones
role: I designed and built the website for the client.

title: TW Trainz
metaTitle: TW Trainz: Sales Training Company Website Case Study
metaDescription: Case study of the TW Trainz website, a clean, editorial site for a sales training company with services, federal resources and experience pages.
summary: A website for a sales training company that builds tailored, learner-centric training programs.
overview: TW Trainz designs customised sales training. The website needed to explain what makes its programs different and to look calm and professional.
I paired a serif headline with a clean sans-serif body, a large team photo and plenty of white space, so the message about tailored training is the first thing visitors read.
does: Pages for About Us, Services, Federal Resources, Experience and Contact
A 'Who is TW TRAINZ?' section that explains the approach in plain language
Clean, readable layout that works on any screen size
role: I designed and built the website for the client.

title: Awesh Portfolio

metaDescription: Case study of a designer portfolio website built with Next.js and TypeScript: dark animated interface, services, process and a hire-me flow.

does: Hero with availability badge, skills and headline numbers
Sections for Work, Services, Process, About and Contact
Scrolling skills marquee and social links
Built with Next.js and TypeScript for speed and search-friendliness

title: Aurora Roast Café
metaTitle: Aurora Roast Café: Coffee House Website Case Study
metaDescription: Case study of the Aurora Roast coffee house website: warm, photo-led design with smooth motion and a table reservation button, built with Next.js.
summary: A website for a small-batch, direct-trade coffee house, with an editorial look, rich photography and a table-reservation button.
overview: A specialty coffee house sells atmosphere and story as much as coffee. This site uses large photography, warm colours and elegant serif type to show that before a visitor reads a word.
Smooth scrolling and gentle animation make the page feel calm, and a Reserve button stays within reach throughout.
does: Layered photographic hero with headline numbers
Sections for About, Coffee, Gallery, Journey and Visit
Table reservation call to action

title: Debit KC, Health Assistant
metaTitle: Debit KC Health Assistant: Personal Website Case Study
metaDescription: Case study of a personal website for a certified health assistant: a friendly introduction, reviews and a make-an-appointment button.
summary: A personal website for a certified health assistant, with an introduction, reviews and a clear appointment button.
overview: A newly certified health assistant needed a simple online presence where people can learn who they are and ask for an appointment.
I built a light, friendly static website with a short introduction, an explanation of how care is planned with each person, and an appointment button in the header at all times.

About and reviews sections
Make-an-appointment call to action

title: Blockchain Exam System
metaTitle: Blockchain Exam System: IPFS & Solidity Case Study
metaDescription: Case study of a tamper-proof online examination system: question papers stored on IPFS, results anchored on-chain with Solidity, run in Docker.
summary: My final-year project: tamper-proof online examinations with question papers on IPFS and results anchored on-chain.
overview: Exam papers and results are valuable, and both can be altered or leaked. This system uses a blockchain to make tampering visible: once a paper or result is recorded, changing it leaves a trace anyone can check.

Question papers are stored on IPFS through Pinata, results are anchored on-chain by a smart contract written in Solidity, and the whole system runs in Docker so it is easy to set up and scale. It was my final-year B.Tech project.
does: Question papers stored on IPFS, so their content can be verified later
Results anchored on-chain so they cannot be changed quietly
Docker-based architecture for easy setup and scaling
Built with Solidity, IPFS, Pinata and Docker
role: I designed and built it as my final-year project.
note: This is a private project, so there is no public demo. I am happy to walk you through it on a call.

title: Blockchain E-Voting
metaTitle: Blockchain E-Voting: Solidity & MetaMask Case Study
metaDescription: Case study of a blockchain voting app: one vote per verified user, MetaMask sign-in and a Solidity contract that makes the tally auditable.
summary: A transparent online voting app with one vote per verified user, MetaMask sign-in and an auditable tally.
overview: Voting systems need two things that pull against each other: every eligible person votes once, and everyone can trust the count. A smart contract helps with the second, because the tally lives on-chain and can be checked by anyone.
In this project each voter is verified with a unique ID, signs in through MetaMask and casts a single vote, recorded by a Solidity contract. A MySQL database supports the off-chain data.
does: One vote per verified user, enforced by a unique ID check
Sign-in and vote signing with MetaMask
A Solidity smart contract that records votes and makes the tally auditable
Built with Solidity, Ethereum, MetaMask and MySQL
role: I designed and built the app and its smart contract.
note: This is a private project, so there is no public demo. I am happy to walk you through it on a call.

title: PhishGuard
metaTitle: PhishGuard: Phishing URL Detection Case Study
metaDescription: Case study of PhishGuard, a phishing link checker with real-time analysis, behavioural signals and zero-day checks, designed to work with a browser extension.
summary: A phishing link checker with real-time analysis, behavioural signals and zero-day checks.
overview: Phishing links often look almost identical to real ones. PhishGuard checks a link in real time so a user can find out whether it is safe before they click it.

The analysis combines real-time checks, behavioural signals about how a page acts, and checks aimed at brand-new threats. It is designed to work alongside a browser extension so the check can happen while browsing.
does: Real-time URL analysis before you click
Behavioural signals and zero-day checks, not only lists of known bad links
Browser extension compatibility
Built with React, TypeScript, Supabase and machine learning
role: I designed and built the product.
note: This is a private project, so there is no public demo. I am happy to walk you through it on a call.

title: Doctor Appointment Booking
metaTitle: Doctor Appointment Booking System Case Study
metaDescription: Case study of a doctor appointment booking platform for patients and doctors, with front-end and back-end built during an internship at Verastix.
summary: A booking platform for patients and doctors, with both the front-end and back-end delivered during my internship at Verastix.
overview: Booking a doctor's appointment should not need phone calls. This platform lets patients find a doctor and choose a time, and gives doctors a clear view of their appointments.
I built it during my full-stack developer internship at Verastix Technology in Nepal, working on both the front-end and the back-end, with a focus on dependable data handling and ease of use.
does: A booking flow for patients
Appointment management for doctors
Front-end and back-end built together with careful data handling
Built with React, Node.js and a database
role: I built the front-end and back-end during my internship.
note: This was built for an employer, so there is no public demo. I am happy to walk you through it on a call.
